result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly, but there is one clear visual defect: overlapping metadata text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, plus a couple of minor truncation/cropping observations.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery time and fee texts overlap each other, rendering as garbled text like '25–3€0dmilinvery • Ramen' instead of '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen'.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata row layout so items are laid out in a horizontal flex/stack with separators, ensuring the time, price, and cuisine labels don't render on top of each other.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' has its name truncated ('Trattoria Piccol') without an ellipsis, and it's unclear if this is intentional carousel cropping or a text overflow issue.
issues.suggestion: Ensure truncated names use an ellipsis (…) or verify the card is intentionally cut off by the horizontal scroll edge.

issues.description: A filter chip at the far right of the category row is cut off with no visible label, which may look broken if the row isn't obviously scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient at the edge or partial-peek styling to signal horizontal scrollability of the filter chips.
